### Added

- (muster) [Run a workflow from a Run it tab on its page, with the tool page's form and result](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2976) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A workflow's page has a Run it tab, where you fill in its inputs, run it and read the result, as on a tool's page. Leaving the tab while a run is in flight asks first: `Leave while the workflow runs?`

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Withhold manager actions without per-user sign-in](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2982) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On an installation whose muster entry has no `authProvider`, the portal also withholds the cluster-manager, model-manager and workspace-manager actions, which failed with an error: `Create cluster` and a cluster's `Delete` are disabled with the reason, and Model hosting and Workspaces say why they offer no action.
- (agent-platform) [Rebuild the agent index when a row's session gate settles](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2990) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After a page reload, a session whose runtime was lost offers `Start a new session with <agent>` again. The change above withheld the button for good while the portal was still reading whether agent-manager is available.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2988) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared CircleCI and GitHub workflows, pre-commit configuration and Makefile.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0
